definitions.de: Grundlage, Basis; Daten, Informationen (häufig in Zusammensetzungen wie ຂໍ້ມູນ = Daten/Information)
definitions.en: Foundation, base; data, information (most commonly found in compounds like ຂໍ້ມູນ meaning 'data/information')
definitions.es: Base, fundamento; datos, información (frecuentemente en compuestos como ຂໍ້ມູນ que significa 'datos/información')
definitions.fr: Base, fondation ; données, informations (surtout dans les composés comme ຂໍ້ມູນ signifiant 'données/informations')
definitions.hi: आधार, नींव; डेटा, जानकारी (अक्सर ຂໍ້ມູນ जैसे यौगिकों में मिलता है जिसका अर्थ 'डेटा/जानकारी' है)
definitions.ja: 基盤、土台；データ、情報（主にຂໍ້ມູນ「データ・情報」などの複合語で使われる）
definitions.km: មូលដ្ឋាន, ទិន្នន័យ, ព័ត៌មាន (ភាគច្រើនប្រើក្នុងពាក្យផ្សំដូចជា ຂໍ້ມູນ មានន័យថា 'ទិន្នន័យ/ព័ត៌មាន')
definitions.ko: 기반, 토대; 데이터, 정보 (주로 ຂໍ້ມູນ '데이터/정보' 같은 복합어로 사용됨)
definitions.ne: आधार, जग; डेटा, जानकारी (प्रायः ຂໍ້ມູນ जस्ता यौगिकमा प्रयोग हुन्छ जसको अर्थ 'डेटा/जानकारी' हो)
definitions.pt: Base, fundação; dados, informações (frequentemente em compostos como ຂໍ້ມູນ significando 'dados/informações')
definitions.th: รากฐาน, ฐาน; ข้อมูล, สารสนเทศ (มักพบในคำประสมเช่น ຂໍ້ມູນ แปลว่า 'ข้อมูล/สารสนเทศ')
definitions.tl: Pundasyon, batayan; datos, impormasyon (madalas makita sa mga tambalang salita tulad ng ຂໍ້ມູນ na nangangahulugang 'datos/impormasyon')
definitions.ur: بنیاد، اساس؛ ڈیٹا، معلومات (اکثر ຂໍ້ມູນ جیسے مرکبات میں پایا جاتا ہے جس کا مطلب 'ڈیٹا/معلومات' ہے)
definitions.vi: Nền tảng, cơ sở; dữ liệu, thông tin (thường dùng trong các từ ghép như ຂໍ້ມູນ nghĩa là 'dữ liệu/thông tin')
definitions.zh: 基础；数据，信息（常见于如ຂໍ້ມູນ（数据/信息）等复合词中）
definitions.zh_Hant: 基礎；數據，資訊（常見於如ຂໍ້ມູນ（數據/資訊）等複合詞中）

definition_en: Foundation, base; data, information (most commonly found in compounds like ຂໍ້ມູນ meaning 'data/information')

lao_examples.lao_script: ຂໍ້ມູນໃນໂທລະສັບຂ້ອຍເຕັມແລ້ວ
lao_examples.romanization: khao mun nai tho la sap khoi tem laew
lao_examples.translation_en: The data/storage on my phone is already full.

lao_examples.lao_script: ເຈົ້າມີຂໍ້ມູນກ່ຽວກັບບ້ານຫຼັງນັ້ນບໍ່
lao_examples.romanization: jao mi khao mun kiao kap ban lang nan bo
lao_examples.translation_en: Do you have any information about that house?
